newsitem.title: BOSNIA: BOSNIA MAY INDUSTRIAL PRICES UP 0.3 PCT MTH/MTH.
newsitem.headline: BOSNIA MAY INDUSTRIAL PRICES UP 0.3 PCT MTH/MTH.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCER PRICES MAY APRIL MAY 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Hercegovina territory. Data for remaining 49 percent are not available. Industrial producer prices in Bosnia's federation in Jan-May 1997 period rose 6.1 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
